Finally, it is worth noting the deliberate omission of try-catch blocks withing the 
majority of the sequence diagrams. While try-catch blocks are critical in handling 
exceptions within the application, ensuing there are no crashes; the author 
found that they did not tend to contribute to the understanding of the 
applications core functionality, and tended to divert the attention away from the 
primary focus of the discussion. Therefore, except for when it’s particularly 
important try catch blocks will be largely overlooked.
